basic_info.description: Experience unparalleled luxury living right on the water at One Steuart Lane! Residence 608 offers a great room for entertaining with a full gourmet kitchen equipped with Gaggenau appliances. The primary bedroom features a walk-in closet and an ensuite spa-like bathroom, designed to rival any 5-star hotel. In-unit conveniences include a laundry closet with hook-ups. Designed by world-renowned architect Skidmore, Ownings & Merrill, amenities at One Steuart are exceptional, with valet parking and 24 hour attended lobby, Resident's lounge with kitchen and waterfront terrace, and fitness/spa facilities. Tucked away on a private lane, One Steuart is within close proximity to the Ferry Building, fabulous restaurants, multiple parks, and Embarcadero Center shops.
